title: Avatar Card
description: The persistent record of one avatar. Everything needed to regenerate the same person, in any tool, at any point in the future. The identity_lock block is the part that must never be edited casually — see the update policy in the skill.

id.description: Stable slug. Never changes, even if the display name does.

revision.description: Bumped on every save. identity_lock changes additionally require identity_revision to bump.

identity_revision.description: Bumped ONLY when identity_lock changes. Two images with the same identity_revision are guaranteed to have been generated from the same physical description.

tagline.description: One line: who this person is.

identity_lock.description: The immutable core. Rendered verbatim into every prompt. Change nothing here without bumping identity_revision and re-shooting the master references.

heritage.description: Ancestry as it reads visually. Phrase descriptively, not as a demographic label.

distinguishing_marks.description: The single highest-value field in the whole card. Specific, locatable marks are what let a human — and a model — verify identity across a set. Two or three is the sweet spot.

grooming.description: Makeup, nails, facial hair. Kept minimal so it does not fight the realism presets.

must_not.description: Explicit anti-drift rules — the traits the model keeps trying to add that would make this a different person.

distinct_from.description: Free text. Use when this avatar must be visibly NOT some other person, e.g. an original reference photo the concept started from.

persona.description: Non-visual context. Shapes wardrobe, environments and the work/lifestyle shots, but never overrides identity_lock.

energy.description: How she carries herself — read by the expression and pose fields.

goal.description: What this person is working towards. Shown on the visual ficha.

represents.description: Brand values / what the avatar stands for. Shown on the visual ficha; does not enter image prompts.

wardrobe_base.description: Worn in every Group A/B/C frame. Frozen for the identity block.

identity_backdrop.description: The single background used across the identity-core block.

environments.description: Real places this person is photographed in, used by Groups D and E.

group_presets.description: Optional per-group override, keyed by shot-suite group id.

identity_anchors.description: The machine-side handles that pin identity across tools. Which ones exist depends on the backend in use — none of them are required for the card to be valid.

identity_token.description: Stable human/model-readable handle, e.g. 'DANIELA-R-30-CO-v1'. Embedded in every prompt as a naming anchor.

seed.description: Numeric seed, for backends that expose one. The OpenAI Images API does not — leave null there and rely on master references.

master_reference_ids.description: Local ids of the master reference images stored alongside the card.

higgsfield_soul_id.description: Soul ID once trained. Works with soul_2 / soul_cinematic only, one per generation.

higgsfield_element_id.description: Reference Element id. Embed as <<<element_id>>> in prompt text.

openai_file_ids.description: Uploaded file ids for the OpenAI images/edits endpoint, if pre-uploaded rather than sent inline.

master_references.description: The canonical images of this person. Reference #1 is the primary — it is sent on every generation.

uri.description: Path, URL, or an idb: handle into the browser tool's local store.

shot_id.description: Set when the reference is itself a generated frame from the suite.

base_prompt.description: The rendered identity paragraph. Derived from identity_lock — regenerate it rather than hand-editing, so the card and the prompt can never disagree.

shot_suite.description: Id of the shot suite this avatar generates against.

history.description: Append-only audit trail. Every card save writes one entry, so an identity change is always traceable to a date and a reason.
